review.tdd: The original S16 external owner route failed a semantic assertion before implementation. Follow-up semantic REDs covered .markdown publication, seeded pre-S16 .markdown identity/locator preservation, diverged indexed-copy protection, expected-prior-hash enforcement, and pre-publication private diagnostics. The S16 case now passes 24 assertions. The seven-field owner correction was also covered by S14 and S15 semantic REDs before implementation. Existing registrar and indexed-origin assertions were retained; no weakening was found.
review.externalSave: The real renderer save-as and quick-save callbacks preserve the chosen external file and existing response shape, publish a separate contained copy and private intent, and receive owner-assigned identity, revision, and job without legacy external markDirty. A second lexical junction alias joins the same document without a duplicate indexing revision. Changed origin content retains the document ID. A seeded pre-S16 .markdown copy reopens and updates at its original locator and ID. Save_document remains restricted to .md publication, while .markdown is permitted only for source-backed opened_markdown/update intents with aliases.
review.failureAndReadOnly: A diverged store copy is protected by registrar and publisher hash checks. Post-publication owner failure retains external file, copy, and retryable intent; pre-publication failure retains the external file and a private diagnostic marker for user-triggered retry. Existing indexed-origin tests cover read-only source selection, hash-only fallback, mismatch and redaction. The source and bundle stdio documentId open fixture adds no file, intent, owner call, or saved-path signal.
review.ownerContract: S14, S15, and S16 producers send exactly {intentId, operation, sourceId, rootFingerprint, sourceRelativeLocator, contentHash, provenance}. The controller strips legacy root arguments, and the worker derives roots from startup configuration, checks supplied identity against the durable intent or receipt, accepts an intentId-only committed replay, and rejects a wrong root fingerprint. S09 crash-window tests pass with configured ingress and a test-only replay hold; production startup replay remains exercised by S10 evidence.
review.closure: The shared #38 entrypoint evidence is now present: SDK clients launch source and generated-bundle stdio servers through production main IPC dispatch bodies, and the registered renderer manual-save IPC callback is exercised with window metadata and post-publication owner failure. Combined S15/S16 evidence supports closing #38 first, then #39 as required by the S16 handoff. Both GitHub issues were OPEN at review time. This review does not mark broader evolving requirements verified.
